ron_commanderskills.villager_battle_horn: Buff friendly units in range: attack speed, damage, and movement speed for a duration.
Requires: 450 food, 700 wood, 450 ore, and Barracks.
Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.villager_rest.desc: Create a healing zone; friendly units in the zone heal per second for a duration.
ron_commanderskills.villager_rest.unlock: Requires: 400 food, 450 wood, 450 ore, and Villager House.
ron_commanderskills.villager_rest.use_hi: Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.villager_cauldron_re: Create a zone; enemy/neutral units inside get a random debuff (Slowness/Weakness/Wither/Poison). Leaving the zone removes it.
Requires: 250 food, 650 wood, 650 ore, and Wheat Farm.
Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.monster_undying.desc: All friendly/ally undead units globally heal 1/2/3 HP per second for 20 seconds.
ron_commanderskills.monster_undying.unlo: Requires: 350 food, 450 wood, 350 ore, and Graveyard.
ron_commanderskills.monster_undying.use_: Left-click to select, then left-click anywhere to cast (global); right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.monster_sculk_ward.d: Friendly/ally units in range don't burn in daylight; undead have 10%/30%/50% chance to revive. Lasts 40/60/80 sec.
ron_commanderskills.monster_sculk_ward.u: Requires: 220 food, 520 wood, 420 ore, and Haunted House.
Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.monster_phantom_stri: Shows a bombing signal circle; after 10/8/6 sec delay, spawns 1/2/3 Creepers 60 blocks above the circle.
Requires: 320 food, 600 wood, 520 ore, and Dark Watchtower.
Left-click to select, then left-click on map to set strike zone; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.monster_transmutatio: Super weapon: Shows a transmutation circle; after 5 sec, converts enemy/neutral units to your undead (converted units take 1 HP/sec until death). Non-convertible units take 40% current HP damage. Diameter 30 blocks. 10 min cooldown (starts on unlock).
Requires: 600 food, 1200 wood, 1200 ore, and Stronghold.
Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.piglin_efficient_por: Global production speed for your unit-producing buildings increases by 40%/50%/60% for 30/40/50 seconds.
Requires: 280 food, 380 wood, 480 ore, and Basic Portal.
Left-click to select, then left-click anywhere to cast (global); right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.piglin_bounty.desc: Mark enemy units in range (gold outline); when a marked unit dies, commander gains 2/4/6× the Bounty skill's use cost. Lasts 1/2/3 min.
ron_commanderskills.piglin_bounty.unlock: Requires: 220 food, 320 wood, 380 ore, and Hoglin Stables.
ron_commanderskills.piglin_bounty.use_hi: Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
Left-click to select first unit, then left-click second unit to swap their positions.
Requires: 260 food, 340 wood, 440 ore, and Basic Portal.
Left-click to select, then left-click two units to swap; right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.piglin_hyper_leap.de: Super weapon: set blue source circle first, then red target circle; all units (allied, neutral, enemy) in blue circle teleport to red. Diameter 20 blocks. 10 min cooldown (starts on unlock).
ron_commanderskills.piglin_hyper_leap.un: Requires: 550 food, 1100 wood, 1100 ore, and Fortress.
ron_commanderskills.piglin_hyper_leap.us: Left-click to select, then left-click map to set blue (source), then red (target); right-click to cancel.
ron_commanderskills.villager_flame_rocke: Super weapon: shows range and bombing signal; after 10 s delay, arrow rain falls for 20 s (1–3 arrows/sec), causing creeper-level explosions and firework particles on impact. 10 min cooldown (starts on unlock).
Requires: 500 food, 1000 wood, 1000 ore, and Castle.
Left-click to select, then left-click on map to cast; right-click to cancel.
